app.name: Stock Manager
app.description: Inventory control: products, stock movements and low-stock alerts.

common.wholeNumber: Use a whole number of 0 or more.
common.positive: Use a whole number greater than 0.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use the account your administrator gave you.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.chartTitle: Stock in and out, last 14 days
dashboard.noMovements: No movements yet. Register stock in or out on a product page.

products.title: Products
products.name: Name
products.emptyAdmin: No products yet. Create the first one with the form above.
products.skuHint: 3-32 letters, digits or dashes. Cannot be changed later.
products.deleteConfirm: Delete this product? This cannot be undone.
products.maxHint: Optional. Leave empty for no limit.
products.maxAboveMin: Must be greater than the minimum.

movements.title: History
movements.empty: No movements yet. Register the first one above.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Create accounts for your team. Operators register movements, suppliers and purchases.

errors.WEB_LOGIN_NOT_ALLOWED: This account is for integrations only and cannot sign in to the web app.
errors.SKU_INVALID: SKU must be 3-32 letters, digits or dashes.
errors.MIN_QUANTITY_INVALID: Minimum quantity must be a whole number of 0 or more.
errors.QUANTITY_INVALID: Quantity must be a whole number greater than zero.
errors.STOCK_CHANGED: Stock changed while saving and is no longer enough. Reload and try again.
errors.PRODUCT_LOCATION_INVALID: Bin location must look like R01-B03-A04-P060-N1.
errors.PRODUCT_IN_PURCHASE_ORDER: This product is on a purchase order and cannot be deleted.
errors.PRODUCT_HAS_MOVEMENTS: This product has stock movements and cannot be deleted.
errors.PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT: Password must have at least {min} characters.
errors.TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Too many failed sign-ins. Wait {minutes} minutes and try again.
errors.SESSION_INVALID: Your session expired. Sign in again.
errors.WEBHOOK_SIGNATURE_INVALID: Webhook signature is missing or wrong.
errors.WEBHOOK_TOO_OLD: Webhook timestamp is more than 5 minutes away from the server clock.
errors.WEBHOOK_NOT_CONFIGURED: Webhooks are not enabled on this server.
errors.INVALID_INPUT: Some fields are invalid. Check them and try again.
errors.MAX_QUANTITY_INVALID: Maximum quantity must be a whole number greater than the minimum ({min}).
errors.AI_NOT_CONFIGURED: Inventory analysis is not enabled on this server.
errors.AI_FAILED: Inventory analysis is unavailable right now. Try again later.
errors.STOCK_UNAVAILABLE: Stock data is unavailable right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.PRICE_INVALID: Price must be between R$ 0,00 and R$ 100.000,00.
errors.COST_INVALID: Cost must be between R$ 0,00 and R$ 100.000,00.
errors.SUPPLIER_DOCUMENT_INVALID: This CNPJ is not valid: it needs 14 digits with correct check digits.
errors.SUPPLIER_HAS_ORDERS: This supplier has purchase orders and cannot be deleted.
errors.PURCHASE_ORDER_EMPTY: A purchase order needs at least one item.
errors.PURCHASE_ORDER_DUPLICATE_ITEM: Each product can appear only once in a purchase order.
errors.PURCHASE_ORDER_STATUS: This purchase order changed status and no longer allows this. Reload the page.
errors.PURCHASE_NOTHING_TO_SUGGEST: No product is below its minimum, so there is nothing to buy.
errors.INVENTORY_COUNT_EMPTY: There are no products to count. Add a product first.
errors.INVENTORY_COUNT_STATUS: This inventory count is already closed. Reload the page.
errors.INVENTORY_NOTHING_COUNTED: Enter at least one counted quantity before applying the count.
errors.COUNTED_INVALID: Use a whole number of 0 or more.
errors.COUNTED_BELOW_RESERVED: Counted {counted} is below the {reserved} units reserved for orders. Count again or release the orders first.

alerts.lowStock: {count, plural, one {# product is} other {# products are}} at or below the minimum.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.subtitle: Totals since the start, average out per day over the last 30 days, and the stock to keep for the next 30 days.
inventory.empty: No products yet. Create one on the Products page.
inventory.aiHint: Claude reads the numbers above and writes what to buy and what is in excess. It does not change any data.

audit.title: Audit
audit.subtitle: The latest 100 product, stock, purchase and sign-in events, newest first.
audit.empty: Nothing recorded yet. Events appear here when products change, stock moves or someone signs in.
audit.partial: Part of the audit log could not be loaded. Showing what is available; reload to try again.

suppliers.title: Suppliers
suppliers.name: Name
suppliers.deleteConfirm: Delete this supplier? This cannot be undone.
suppliers.empty: No suppliers yet. Add the first one with the form above.

purchases.title: Purchases
purchases.suggestHint: Creates a draft with every product whose available units are below the minimum, enough to reach the maximum (or twice the minimum), at the last cost.
purchases.empty: No purchase orders yet. Create one above or let the system suggest one from low stock.
purchases.receiveConfirm: Receive this order? Every item is added to stock and its cost updated.

counts.title: Stock counts
counts.startHint: Takes a snapshot of every product's quantity. Count the shelves, enter what you find, review the differences, then apply.
counts.empty: No counts yet. Start one to compare the shelves with the system.
counts.name: Product
counts.nothingEntered: Enter at least one counted quantity.
counts.applyConfirm: Apply this count? Every counted product is set to its counted quantity with a stock movement.
counts.cancelConfirm: Cancel this count? Stock does not change.
counts.hint: Leave a field empty to skip that product. Differences are booked as stock in or out when the count is applied.
